adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` defines computed keys as `[z.string().toString()]: z.number()` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]: z.unknown().optional()`. In a JS object literal this evaluates the expressions immediately, producing a single literal property name (e.g., something like "ZodString" / "[object Object]"), not a pattern like “any key whose value is a number”. As a result, `minimumTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(response)` will wrongly require that junk literal key to exist and be a number, causing valid token responses (that typically only have `access_token` and other fields like `expires_in`/`expiry_date`) to fail validation and throw `Invalid refreshed tokens were returned` when credential sharing/sync is enabled.
